summary: The diff implements Reflect.isExtensible in its stub file and follows the spec. Step 1 throws a TypeError when the argument is not an Object. Step 2 returns ? ops::is_extensible(agent, target) wrapped as a Boolean, so the abrupt completion propagates. Step comments are kept directly above the matching code. The `let _ = (this, new_target);` line only silences unused bindings. Only the one in-scope file changed, the gate reports 0 regressions and 0 lint flags, and the 8 newly passing tests fit a change this size. I could not see the body of ops::is_extensible, so I am relying on the helper being the spec's [[IsExtensible]] dispatch; the build and test results are consistent with that.
